components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill shaped action button with purple glow on hover
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a855f7; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9333ea; box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(168,85,247,0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); }

narrative.overview: LifeVault pairs deep dark mode surfaces with high-luminance crimson and royal purple glassmorphic accents, evoking clinical precision and urgent biological monitoring.
keyCharacteristics: Pitch-black void backgrounds with dot-matrix vector grid overlays.
Liquid glassmorphism with multi-pass gradient borders and backdrop blur.
Dual typography hierarchy pairing sans-serif structural precision with serif emphasis.

rules.name: The Crimson Urgency Rule
rules.body: Crimson accents are reserved for emergency requisitions, stock shortages, and ABO incompatibility warnings.

dos: Do use Instrument Serif italics exclusively for emphasized key words within headings.
Do preserve high-contrast legibility for clinical blood group data.
donts: Don't use solid light backgrounds; LifeVault is built exclusively on deep dark mode aesthetics.
